text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital isn't feeling well, so the
two of us
decide to visit a shrine.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Mumble, mumble...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear her praying fervently. She must
have been
enduring some serious—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Please bring happiness to all Umas...
Please bring
happiness to all Umas...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I hope my prayer reaches the
gods...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I guess I forgot where I was!
Although, clearly
this isn't the shrine in
my room...
choice_data_list: Are you sure you don't mind about ...
Are you sure you don't mind about ...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I guess shrines always compel me to pray
for my
oshis' happiness.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But we came here in hopes my condition
will soon
improve. Right, I've put my
thoughts in order, so
let me try again...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You... You're absolutely right!
choice_data_list: No, being honest with your feeling...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Praying for the happiness of all
Umas is the same as praying for my own
happiness! That means I've been praying
for myself all along, like I was supposed
to!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Guehuehue! I'm ready and waiting for all
the
benefits coming my way!
Oh? It's Digital! ♪ Heeey!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Nyah! I know that voice!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Woow, what a coincidence! Are you here
praying
with your trainer?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Th-th-th-that's right! You too?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yup! ♪ I came here to ask the gods to
help me
interact with more fans as an
Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And they answered my prayer right
away! ☆ I'm so
happy!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aghhh! What a bright smile! The
pleasure is all
mine!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yeaaaagkh! I so, so happy! She sho...
amashing!
Kyuut... Hya...ppy... My
bocabuary...
choice_data_list: Good for the both of you.
I'm glad for both of you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Agnes Digital's prayers
were also
answered immediately, and
thus, leading to her
full recovery.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bing!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hm? Looks like I got a message...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wh-wh-wh-what?! The performance has
been
postponed?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aaarrrghhhgrrrrr! You've got to be
kidding! I was
looking forward to it so
much!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The news throws Agnes Digital into a
funk, and
her mood doesn't recover for
some time.
